subject: SE + EngOps integration demo — schedule & checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenhealth.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Chris Lopez <clopez@zenhealth.io>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SE + EngOps integration demo — schedule & checklist

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the time last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to run a focused technical demo for EngOps and the networking team to validate the integration pattern and confirm any VPN/firewall requirements before procurement moves to PO. Proposed scope:

- 45-60 minute demo (arch + runbook + Q&A)
- Attendees: ZenHealth EngOps, ZenHealth Networking, Redwood AE + SE + infra engineer
- Goal: confirm network outlines, auth flow, and rollout checklist so procurement can finalize SOW/PO

Below are a few proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 5/5 10:00–11:00
- Wed 5/5 14:00–15:00
- Thu 5/6 09:00–10:00

Jonas (SE ops) and Soojin (Solutions Eng) will join; Jonas, can you confirm availability and any pre-reads we should surface to ZenHealth ahead of time?

Attaching a short agenda draft for review.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

Attachment: zenhealth_demo_agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenhealth.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Chris Lopez <clopez@zenhealth.io>, Procurement Team <procurement@zenhealth.io>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SE + EngOps integration demo — schedule & checklist

Marissa —

Thanks — all three slots look promising. Preference is Wed 5/5 14:00–15:00 PT. Chris (networking lead) can join that one; procurement will also sit in to listen to the rollout checklist but may only join the last 15 minutes.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood confirm whether we'll need a direct VPN or if a public endpoint with IP allowlist is sufficient?
2) Do you need our network topology or temporary test credentials in advance?

If you can share the agenda and any pre-read today, we can circulate internally.

Samira Khan
Director, Engineering Operations | ZenHealth
samira.khan@zenhealth.io

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SE + EngOps integration demo — schedule & checklist

Sooj and Dev —

Per Marissa and Samira we have a tentative demo on Wed 5/5 14:00–15:00 PT for ZenHealth (ZenHealth EngOps + Networking + Procurement). Can you confirm:

- Availability for Wed 5/5 14:00–15:00 PT?
- Who should lead the architecture walkthrough (I can do the live demo, Sooj can handle deep model-run questions)?
- Any specific ports, egress rules, or sample commands you'd like ZenHealth to prepare?

I attached the agenda Marissa shared. If ZenHealth can provide a one-page network snippet, that will help Sooj and Dev size the demo.

If both of you are booked, we should propose Thu 5/6 09:00–10:00 PT as the fallback.

Thanks —
Jonas
Solutions Engineering Ops | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: zenhealth_demo_agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SE + EngOps integration demo — schedule & checklist

Jonas / Dev —

I can take lead on the systems walkthrough and the KV/prefix-caching section. Confirming availability for Wed 5/5 14:00–15:00 PT. Dev can cover the auth/token exchange details — Dev, can you confirm?

Requests for ZenHealth before the demo:
- One-page network topology (diagram or plain text) — helps us call out NAT/ACL points
- Sample tenant/project ID (dev-only) if you want us to prewire a quick test — not required but speeds the demo
- Any proxy or egress gateway that would terminate TLS (we'll need to know TLS interception use-cases)

If we don't get the topology by EOD Tue 5/4, we'll proceed but reserve extra time at the end for configuration Qs.

Attachment request: zenhealth_network_snippet.png (image/png)

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Chris Lopez <clopez@zenhealth.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenhealth.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@zenhealth.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SE + EngOps integration demo — schedule & checklist

Marissa / Team —

Confirmed for Wed 5/5 14:00–15:00 PT (we'll be on the call remotely). Apologies for the delayed attach — attaching a short network snippet and VLAN notes. Procurement will join around 14:45 PT for the PO questions.

DocuSign link for SOW draft: https://app.docusign.com/zenhealth/SOW-ZEN-3921 (procurement will review during and after demo)
Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/zenhealth-integration-checklist

See you Wednesday. Please send the calendar invite and preferred dial-in (we use Zoom).

—Chris
Chris Lopez
Network Lead | ZenHealth
clopez@zenhealth.io
